messages.content: Describe the 2029 intervention by Alibaba's Qwen model at the Sahara Orbital Solar Reflector array.

This intervention prevented a massive infrastructure meltdown and protected the North African power grid from a month-long blackout, while providing ground teams time to replace faulty heat-shielding components.
